eyebrow.en: Compare model-spec snapshots with wired fields and distinguish relevant changes from informational deltas.

headline.zh:
配置已经接好，
再看哪些规格变了
headline.en:
Your configuration is wired.
See which specs changed.

sub.zh: 将模型规格快照与已配置字段对照，区分直接相关与仅供参考的变化。
sub.en: Compare model-spec snapshots with wired fields and distinguish relevant changes from informational deltas.

caption.zh: 配置快照 · 字段差异

body.zh: Affects 区分相关和 informational 项。
body.en: Affects distinguishes relevant and informational items.

body.zh: 使用本地或嵌入 registry 完成 diff。
body.en: Use a local or embedded registry for diffs.

body.zh: 每个 delta 附字段、旧值、新值与说明。
body.en: Each delta carries a field, old value, new value and note.

title.zh: 让变更与自己的配置对上

body.zh: 模型规格更新后，context、缓存模式或工具调用约定是否与你有关，取决于当前接入了什么。DropDiff 将 WiredConfig 和策展注册表做字段比较，保留 Before、After、Affects 和严重度，帮助定位需要进一步核对的项。
body.en: Whether a context, cache or tool-call change matters depends on the configuration already in use. DropDiff compares a WiredConfig with a curated registry and retains Before, After, Affects and severity fields to identify items for further review.

body.zh: 实际调用核心 differ，分别以 implicit 和 off 的缓存模式读取相同快照。输出只证明字段相关性规则的执行，没有查询最新模型定价、SDK commit 或平台配置。
body.en: The real differ compares the same snapshot with implicit and off cache modes. The output exercises field-relevance rules; it does not query current pricing, SDK commits or platform settings.

alt.zh: 实际调用核心 differ，分别以 implicit 和 off 的缓存模式读取相同快照。输出只证明字段相关性规则的执行，没有查询最新模型定价、SDK commit 或平台配置。
alt.en: The real differ compares the same snapshot with implicit and off cache modes. The output exercises field-relevance rules; it does not query current pricing, SDK commits or platform settings.

body.zh: config 解析或读取模型配置，spec 加载 YAML DropSpec，differ 先寻找明确 successor，没有时可按同 vendor 的较新记录回退。render 输出相关或 informational 标签；check/list 可离线，sync 才拉取远程 registry。
body.en: config parses or reads model settings; spec loads YAML DropSpecs. The differ prefers explicit successors and can fall back to newer records from the same vendor. render labels relevant and informational changes. check/list can run offline; sync fetches a registry.

alt.zh: config 解析或读取模型配置，spec 加载 YAML DropSpec，differ 先寻找明确 successor，没有时可按同 vendor 的较新记录回退。render 输出相关或 informational 标签；check/list 可离线，sync 才拉取远程 registry。
alt.en: config parses or reads model settings; spec loads YAML DropSpecs. The differ prefers explicit successors and can fall back to newer records from the same vendor. render labels relevant and informational changes. check/list can run offline; sync fetches a registry.

body.zh: 比较依赖注册表维护质量。明确 successor 优于同 vendor 的日期回退；价格只在单位相同时比较。报告用于筛选待核对变化，不替代供应商来源核验。
body.en: Comparison depends on registry quality. Explicit successors are preferred over same-vendor date fallback, and prices compare only when units match. Reports help select changes to verify rather than replacing source verification.

alt.zh: 比较依赖注册表维护质量。明确 successor 优于同 vendor 的日期回退；价格只在单位相同时比较。报告用于筛选待核对变化，不替代供应商来源核验。
alt.en: Comparison depends on registry quality. Explicit successors are preferred over same-vendor date fallback, and prices compare only when units match. Reports help select changes to verify rather than replacing source verification.

title.en: A snapshot is not a live quote

body.zh: 请核对 registry 的日期与来源，sync 也只获取其配置的数据。
body.en: Inspect registry dates and sources; sync only fetches the configured data source.

note.zh: 实际调用核心 differ，分别以 implicit 和 off 的缓存模式读取相同快照。输出只证明字段相关性规则的执行，没有查询最新模型定价、SDK commit 或平台配置。
note.en: The real differ compares the same snapshot with implicit and off cache modes. The output exercises field-relevance rules; it does not query current pricing, SDK commits or platform settings.

body.zh: implicit 模式将缓存价格项标记为相关。
body.en: Implicit cache mode marks the cache-price field as relevant.

steps.output:
Local registry snapshot: 2026-08-09; fixture cache_mode=implicit

glm-5.3  2026-07-29  [GLM]
  ✓ pricing.cache: 0.28 CNY/M -> 0.14 CNY/M
      affects your wired config — implicit cache price
  ✓ quants: fp16,int8 -> fp16,int8,fp8
      informational — quants removed=[] added=[fp8]
2 delta(s): 0 red, 2 green, 0 amber

body.zh: off 模式下同一字段作为 informational 显示。
body.en: With cache off, the same field is informational.

steps.output:
Local registry snapshot: 2026-08-09; fixture cache_mode=off

glm-5.3  2026-07-29  [GLM]
  ✓ pricing.cache: 0.28 CNY/M -> 0.14 CNY/M
      informational — implicit cache price
  ✓ quants: fp16,int8 -> fp16,int8,fp8
      informational — quants removed=[] added=[fp8]
2 delta(s): 0 red, 2 green, 0 amber

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。演示使用完整的显式配置与本地 registry，不需要模型服务或用户配置。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. The demo uses a complete explicit configuration and local registry, without a model service or user settings.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/dropdiff.git
cd dropdiff
go build -o dropdiff .

go run ./examples/presentation implicit
go run ./examples/presentation off

limitations.zh: 本次未核验 bundled registry 的价格或来源引用，不能当作实时供应商信息。
limitations.en: Bundled prices and source references were not verified as live vendor information.

limitations.zh: 同 vendor 回退匹配可能包含并非直接升级关系的模型。
limitations.en: Same-vendor fallback can include models that are not direct upgrades.

limitations.zh: 工具只报告差异，不修改 Agent 配置或执行升级。
limitations.en: The tool reports differences without changing agent configuration or performing upgrades.
